title: veronica anagallis-aquatica var. lepida
intro: Veronica anagallis-aquatica var. lepida, commonly known as Marsh Speedwell, is a plant species belonging to the Veronicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Speedwell are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
